name: Bobby Swalstad
occupation: Washakie County assessor-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Bobby Swalstad is the Washakie County assessor-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Nancy Quinn, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election results list him as the winner of the assessor race.
